messages:
Carla: Quick check — SI partner (Deepa) is ready to board a hardware + connector listing. They asked what security artifacts we need (SOC2, pen test, questionnaire, redaction), who owns uploads, and how this aligns with the joint announcement.
Sam: High level: we need SOC2 report (PDF), third-party pen-test report (redacted), completed vendor security questionnaire, and a manifest of artifacts + owners. Also an attestation from the partner that nothing is PII. :locked:
Deepa: We have SOC2 Type II from last quarter. Pen test is with a 3rd party next week; report expected ~2 weeks after. Questionnaire — we can fill yours. Need to confirm where to upload the reports.
Kyle: For uploads we prefer presigned S3 objects into a restricted bucket. TTL 7 days by default. We can create an access map so only security and partnerships can GET.
Carla: Ok — timeline question: partner wants joint announcement 2025-03-15. That means we need all artifacts reviewed and redaction sign-off one week before — so target artifacts in by 2025-03-08.
Sam: If pen test report contains internal IPs/endpoint fingerprints we need the vendor to produce a redacted version for storage. Also require a signed attestation (one page) saying report is safe to share with marketplace reviewers.
Deepa: Understood. I can ask pen-test vendor for a redacted export + attestation. Who signs the attestation on Redwood side?
Carla: Partnership lead can countersign. I'll own the announcement SLA. Sam, can security do a quick acceptance (ok/no-go) within 48h of uploads?
Sam: Yes, security will triage within 48 hours. If there are redaction gaps we'll send back a list of items to remove.
Kyle: Presign plan: I can spin up a presign set and return links. Pattern: s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/{partner}/{artifact_name}. Example command:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/deepa/si-pen-report.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
I will create an "owner" label on each object and a mapping file owners.csv in the same folder.
artifact-uploader-bot: presign links created for /deepa/ — 5 objects, TTL 7d.
Carla: Nice, please put owners.csv with columns: filename, owner_email, confidentiality_level. Use "redacted" in the filename if it's the redacted report.
Sam: Also add a short scoping note for the pen test (pages) that explains what was in-scope vs out-of-scope. That helps reviewers assess residual risk.
Deepa: Will do. I'll also include contact for the pen-test lead and the SI security engineer.
Carla: Action items: 1) Deepa to upload SOC2 PDF, pen-test redacted + raw (if allowed), questionnaire, attestation, owners.csv by 2025-03-08. 2) Kyle to generate presigns and lock down S3 ACLs. 3) Sam to review artifacts within 48h and return redaction requests. 4) Carla to confirm announcement sign-off once security clears.
Deepa: Assigning to our security lead Priya; she'll handle uploads and coordinate vendor for redaction.
Sam: One more: please include a brief privacy & data-flow diagram (1 page) if the connector touches customer data — reviewers expect it.
Carla: Good call. Deepa, can you add that to the upload bundle?
Deepa: Yes — adding a diagram and the questionnaire answers.
Carla: Perfect. I'll block the date 2025-03-08 for final artifacts and 2025-03-14 as internal dry-run for announcement. Thanks everyone :tada:
notes: thread about onboarding SI + hardware partner artifacts for marketplace listing; coordination on uploads, redaction, presign links, review SLA, and announcement timing
